name: balanced
description: A general-purpose profile — the drive the OEM should have shipped. Reasonable OP, modest pSLC, SuperSpeed forced, factory-safe thermal setpoint. Suitable as a daily-driver USB stick for mixed read/write.

capacity_impact.method: usable ≈ advertised × (1 − OP/100) × (1 − pSLC/100). Modest OP + modest pSLC.

host_recommendations.partition_scheme: GPT or MBR, filesystem of choice
notes: Factory firmware on cheap drives often ships with 0-5% OP and no SuperSpeed force. This profile fixes both without exotic trade-offs.
Expect ~10-20% better sustained write than factory, same peak sequential, same capacity-ish.
